E4Plus1.uk.title: The Inbetweeners
E4Plus1.uk.description: First Day: Smash hit comedy about four teenagers. Will (Simon Bird), whose parents have divorced, must move to a new area and change from private to comprehensive school. (S1 Ep1/6)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Inbetweeners
E4Plus1.uk.description: Bunk Off: Will, Simon, Jay and Neil bunk off school. They go to Neil's house to get drunk, and Simon has a vodka-induced romantic revelation about his childhood sweetheart Carli. (S1 Ep2/6)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: On the 'box this time: Squid Game: The Challenge, I'm a Celebrity... Get Me Out of Here!, The Crown, Deal or No Deal, Planet Earth III, Made in Chelsea and Saving Lives at Sea. (S22 Ep12) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: What do Britain's top armchair critics think of Squid Game: The Challenge, The Couple Next Door, The Toy Hospital, Survivor, Vinnie Jones in the Country and Lorraine? (S22 Ep13) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: Monster Hunter
E4Plus1.uk.description: (2020) Paul WS Anderson's sci-fi action starring Milla Jovovich, based on the game of the same name. A US Army Ranger must fight her way out of a parallel world full of monsters.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Unplugged: Claire and Phil challenge the family to a digital detox contest. (S2 Ep5)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Hollyoaks Omnibus
E4Plus1.uk.description: Mercedes wants to know what Jenson's up to. Warren makes a decision, but is he too late? Friends support Diane and Tony. And Rex experiments with his image for the first time in public. [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: Hollyoaks
E4Plus1.uk.description: Warren decides who he wants, but is he too late? Meanwhile, friends gather around to support Diane and Tony.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Hollyoaks
E4Plus1.uk.description: Rex braves his first public outing while experimenting with his image at an LGBTQ+ club night. And a shocking turn of events at The Loft relaunch party puts all eyes on Mercedes...

E4Plus1.uk.title: Rude(ish) Tube Shorts
E4Plus1.uk.description: A short, cheeky clip from Rude Tube's naughty little sister, Rude(ish) Tube, featuring sports of the lawnmower, motorbike and bicycle variety.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: El Greco: Gordon Ramsay visits struggling Greek restaurant El Greco, where the owners have secretly recruited 'Chef Mike' the microwave to help them out on a daily basis. (S5 Ep9) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4Plus1.uk.description: Geoff the Pleaser: Geoff struggles to balance demands from the Jenkintown Posse and Erica. Adam faces a crisis of confidence over his career path. (S7 Ep13)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Preventa Mode: As Valentine's Day approaches, Barry is shocked when an attractive teaching assistant agrees to go out with him. (S7 Ep14)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Fears: When Phil and Luke embark on a discovery expedition underneath the house, Phil tries not to let his fear of the dark and of creepy crawlies get the best of him. (S1 Ep16)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Truth Be Told: After reconnecting on Facebook, Phil invites his old high school girlfriend to drop by the house, but the friendly visit quickly turns into trouble. (S1 Ep17)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Married at First Sight Australia
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: The dinner party descends into chaos when a shock return re-ignites old feuds and exposes fresh cracks in multiple marriages. (S13 Ep12)

E4Plus1.uk.title: First Dates
E4Plus1.uk.description: Sexual health advisor Liza meets father-of-five Simon. Singer Saskia dates Luke the magician. And a car buff from Grimsby meets a self-confessed 'nerd' who's yet to fall in love. (S17 Ep5)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: Michon's: Can Gordon help the unwell owner of a family-run Atlanta smokehouse address his daughter's hands-off management style? (S5 Ep11)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: 24 Minutes: In a parody of the action series 24, Bart and Lisa must stop bullies releasing a stink bomb at school. (S18 Ep21/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: You Kent Always Say What You Want: After spilling coffee on his lap, Kent Brockman swears on live TV and gets fired. So Kent and Lisa team up to broadcast inconvenient truths. (S18 Ep22/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Kiss: In honour of her late grandmother, Gloria decides to cook traditional Colombian meals, which is met with some ribbing from Jay. And Claire becomes overbearing. (S2 Ep2)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Earthquake: An earthquake traps Claire in the bathroom with the plumber. Manny has an existential crisis while he's out with Jay. (S2 Ep3)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Married at First Sight Australia
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: The dinner party descends into chaos when a shock return re-ignites old feuds and exposes fresh cracks in multiple marriages. (S13 Ep12)

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: Dance Moms: A New Era
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series - Out with the Bleu, in with the New: Coach Glo is under pressure to build a new project after the catastrophic end to Studio Bleu. Will her daughter Kaeli help? (S2 Ep1)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Homer Goes to Prep School: Homer joins an off-the-grid survivalist group who have a top-secret doomsday bunker. (S24 Ep9/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: A Test Before Trying: When the school's threatened with closure because of low test scores, its fate rests with one student who missed the exam: Bart. (S24 Ep10/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Hollyoaks
E4Plus1.uk.description: Can Warren trust Jenson? Diane makes a decision as her family struggle with her prognosis. And a resident is forced to reveal the truth.

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: Married at First Sight...
E4Plus1.uk.description: ...Australia - Brand new series: The second Commitment Ceremony erupts with accusations, heartbreak and a shock exit, leaving the experiment permanently shaken. (S13 Ep13)

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: Made in Chelsea
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: Jazz decides it's time to come clean about her feelings, but how will Inga react? Philip ramps up his feud with Chuggs. And Freddy's torn between Angus and Jack. (S31 Ep4)

E4Plus1.uk.description: What do the Goggleboxers think of Squid Game: The Challenge, The Couple Next Door, Strictly Come Dancing, The Graham Norton Show, Planet Earth III, and Jingle All the Way? (S22 Ep14)

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: The workshop gets a new wall and floor. Meanwhile, Sam Lovegrove mends Dom's vintage motorbike for a nail-biting cliff top trial. Plus, cider, an orchard and an auction are on the menu. S1 Ep4

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Incredible Journeys with Simon Reeve
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Simon recalls some of the most dangerous experiences of his travels, from coming under fire in war-torn Mogadishu to squaring off with a female wrestler in Mexico City. S1 Ep2

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Bangers & Cash: Restoring Classics
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Wooden Boat: The team restore a 1988 Golf GTI Convertible - an iconic hot hatch - along with a wooden launch boat and a catch-up with a Mk1 Austin Mini. S2 Ep3
